issues.where: the large bubble on the right and the splash left of center
issues.what: the bubble reads as a polished solid dome pasted onto the pool; the splash is a thick opaque sheet with isolated beadlike droplets and little disturbance below it
issues.fix: Give the bubble a thin irregular film, break the splash into finer translucent sheets and droplets, and carry displacement and ripples into the surrounding pool.

issues.where: right crop, pink fluid edge along the foreground bank
issues.what: the rippled surface stops at a broad, untextured pink ribbon that follows the rock like a mesh skirt; the same sharp border is visible in the wide shot
issues.fix: Replace the ribbon with a shallow meniscus, irregular wetting and mineral deposits, and let smaller ripples and reflections reach the bank.

issues.where: right crop, the pale animal behind the foreground animal
issues.what: the right side of its body ends on a nearly vertical straight edge in open space, making it look clipped rather than partly buried or occluded
issues.fix: Restore a naturally rounded body silhouette or obscure it with real foreground relief, with a contact shadow at the ground.

issues.where: right crop, side of the foreground animal's head and its feet
issues.what: a dark almond-shaped crease reads as an eye; the feet and mouth tendrils have weak contact with the ground and the coat has an almost uniform pale finish
issues.fix: Remove the eye-shaped crease, plant the feet and tendrils with local shadows, and vary the wetness and sediment on the lower body.

issues.where: lower-left crop, pink pools and pale ground around the plant bases
issues.what: long soft streaks continue over the ground and across successive pools, with little change in relief or material at the banks
issues.fix: Separate the wet, dry and mineral surfaces and break up the stretched streaks with local relief and irregular boundaries.

issues.where: lower-right crop, around the stalk entering the pool
issues.what: the ripples look nearly uniform up to the stalk and scarcely respond to the obstacle; the stalk appears to end abruptly in the surface
issues.fix: Add a broken reflection, a tight wet contact ring, and ripples deflected around the stalk.

issues.where: top-right crop, fine red tendrils and hanging loops against the fog
issues.what: several thin strands have pale fringes, speckled edges, and wispy streaks that look like a cutout mask
issues.fix: Render the narrow strands as geometry with clean coverage and consistent focus blur, and distinguish the water drops from the strand silhouettes.

issues.where: middle distance just above the pond, between the foreground stalks and the animal on the right
issues.what: the white haze reads as a broad wash that reduces contrast more than it describes vapor with depth or illumination
issues.fix: Modulate fog density by depth and height, and introduce localized lit and shadowed structure above the water.

issues.where: right crop, small near bubble against the pool
issues.what: the dome has a soft molded highlight and almost no distinct meniscus or ring in the uniform surface texture around it
issues.fix: Couple the bubble to the surrounding surface with a subtle meniscus and interrupted ripples, and vary the film highlight with thickness.
